1479-2841-3318-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1021-5411-6303-6664.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

529-3197-4785-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4068-4311-5078-8171.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-2292-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-6495-7452.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-7452.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

413-4559-4772-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4559-4772-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3277-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Izzet Chronarch from exile to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

2438-6258--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

1394-2060-4772-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doubling Season.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doubling Season.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

489-1117-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

4824-5963-7066.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kyoshi's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1781-1978-6479.description:
Cause Rainveil Rejuvenator to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

552-5200-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven basic Swamps.
552-5200-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Sword of the Paruns attached using Cabal Stronghold's ability by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least seven {B}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
552-5200-6474.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2558-4186-5330-6701.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-5330-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

2043-4772-5231-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

273-3156-4763-5173.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Shambling Ghast.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, targeting Koll.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

803-2557-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

101-372-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1974-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1974-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Gargantuan has a power of at least 2.
1974-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Quicksilver Gargantuan and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Quicksilver Gargantuan to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-4763-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has haste and that can be cast using three colored mana of a single color.
1069-4763-5499.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature with haste.
Activate the creature by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Koll triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

64-1987-2103-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
64-1987-2103-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-4050.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-4304-5641.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen
719-4304-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Xenograft, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Xenograft, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-2335-4474-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
Paradise Mantle attached to Barrenton Medic.
2092-2335-4474-4762.description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability and Barrenton Medic by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid and Barrenton Medic's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

2363-2626-4986.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1687-3389-4050-4772.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
